select HISTORY_ID, PRODUCT_ID, case when T.TRADE_TYPE = 'SELL'then '판매' when T.TRADE_TYPE = 'BUY' then '구매' else '경매' end as "TRADE_TYPE", SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE, to_char(COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "COMPLETED_AT_STR", COMPLETED_AT, P.TITLE, case when U.IS_DELETED = 1 then '탈퇴한 회원' else U.NICKNAME end as "PARTNER_NICKNAME" from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T join PRODUCTS P using (PRODUCT_ID) join USERS U on U.USER_NO = case when T.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} then T.SELLER_NO when T.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} then T.BUYER_NO end where (BUYER_NO = #{userNo} or SELLER_NO = #{userNo})
order by COMPLETED_AT desc
offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{size} rows only

select count(*) from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T join PRODUCTS P using (PRODUCT_ID) join USERS U on U.USER_NO = case when T.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} then T.SELLER_NO when T.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} then T.BUYER_NO end where (BUYER_NO = #{userNo} or SELLER_NO = #{userNo})
mapper.insert: insert into TRANSACTION_HISTORY (PRODUCT_ID, TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE) values (#{productId}, #{tradeType}, #{sellerNo}, #{buyerNo}, #{finalPrice})
mapper.select: select case when R.REVIEW_ID is not null then 'true' else 'false' end as reviewWrited from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T join PRODUCTS P on T.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID left join REVIEWS R on T.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID and R.REVIEWER_NO = 1 where T.HISTORY_ID = #{historyId}
